name: sorbe
description: SORBE — India bag-charm storefront (Next.js + Medusa v2)

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d

pnpm.comment: All @mikro-orm/* packages MUST resolve to one version — a mixed tree fails in confusing ways (invalid `id NOT IN ()` SQL on cart creation, or `getEventManager().getSubscribers is not a function`). @mikro-orm/cli needs pinning too: @mikro-orm/migrations pulls it, and it drags its own core along. 6.6.14 is the floor for Medusa 2.20.1, which calls EventManager#getSubscribers — added after 6.4.x.
